BL-1358 — The Gherkin mutation harness has no per-mutant time ceiling anywhere, so one hung mutant holds a worker until a human notices - measured at 808 seconds
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 from the hardender's rule proposal, which was rejected as
scoped rather than dismissed - it proposed authoring guidance filed at the role
that CATCHES this. Full reasoning:
`backlog/evidence/BL-1357-BL-1358-rule-proposal-disposition-20260903.md`.
Approval context: Two things need your eye, one of them a genuine fork.
THE FORK, declared in ruling_options: whether a timed-out mutant should FAIL the hardener's gate the way a surviving mutant does, or be reported as its own non-blocking category. Option 1 is conservative - a hang is treated as "not proven killed…
BL-1358 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1358" (or "reject BL-1358 <reason>") to act.
